conclusion.recommendation: Add an opt-in independently frozen existing-member-scope selector plus one shared actual-member expansion contract. A member scope is an addressable closed membership inventory, never a synthetic entity/owner/event and never a replacement for selected source CID/RID dependencies.
conclusion.why: Existing map v3 and request selection v1 bind exactly one actual owner per source target. Treating plural source scope as one ungrounded owner loses honest per-member footprint; enumerating a fixed number of hand/garment/lamp targets in reusable source invents cardinality. Explicitly closed request scopes solve addressability without source-specific count rules.
conclusion.not_a_current_lock_bypass_finding: Current property checks conservatively deny unknown overlap, and declared part/whole locks already propagate overlap. Six pure probes show unsupported multi-owner shapes and exact scalar behavior, not an accepted malicious aggregate proof or actual3CID admission.

rules: Existing core_role/selected_existing_owner point rows remain permitted in mapv4; introduced point behavior remains existing synthetic-origin behavior. Scope selector is existing-only with introduced_by=null and cannot own add_entity/remove_entity or expand new members.

Every map target still has exact selected fact/receiver or own sealed common/branch guard use. Guard-only scopes cannot enter via optional member or foreign presentation. IDs/namespace do not supply semantics.

If a fact target is a scope, E/P/preservation are explicitly distributive over every actual member. A reviewer must establish the same stated value/property/operation applies to each, from positive source/application. No partial interpretation, cross-product receiver expansion or unspecified default. Uniform property assignment is a deliberate source contract, not a tag inference.

If a fact receiver is a scope, all of its actual members become receivers of that one actual point/each-member target assignment. Receiver status records affected permission scope; it does not automatically copy the E property/value to receivers. This matches existing receiver semantics.

Collective arrangement/styling belongs on an honest existing point (image/scene/wearer/declared real object), with full actual scope receivers. Do not force an each-member value for a genuinely collective constraint. If no honest point or source-compatible distributive interpretation exists, remain pending rather than invent aggregate/event owner.

Property/typed value/operation remain manually authored exact literals, and source E effect_set covers every original chosen mutation. Scope expansion only substitutes actual addresses; it never creates P/E modes or semantic values and never turns chosen E into a frozen P. Original source-unit/RID/language coverage and catalog role proof remain required.

selection_rules: Composer explicitly selects after core from immutable retrieval descriptors; no pack rewrite/republication and no core enrichment from candidate. Selection lists scope ID/hash, not a post-core author-supplied mutable member list/subset. Scope contents come only from independently frozen core.

All actually selected source nodes require exact target coverage, same CID/RID/meaning/proof and exact selected dependency closure. Reject missing/extra/unused selection entries/targets, wrong tag, wrong scope hash, partial scope, foreign owner, stale core/graph, or shared-child sameCID with different mapping/RID.

Do not default to only existing scope, primary/secondary role, first match, shared owner kind, all descendants or previously mentioned members.64entry and32binding bounds stay; actual expanded members are a separate derived ledger, not additional source bindings.

A post-core caller choice can pick among independently declared local scopes only. It cannot narrow a source requirement of all scoped members to an arbitrary predeclared subset; matching the original/application whole boundary is still manually authored and enforced by explicit guards where expressible. Unexpressed boundary truth remains a semantic review limitation.

limits: One explicit universal binder and one scalar inner frozen_value/frozen_entity_relation/owner_relation/preserve_established_scope rule per source rule. No existential/default matching, recursion, nested quantifiers, source-time arbitrarymemberordinal, Cartesian pair expansion or body-count evaluator in the minimal implementation. Proposed entity.worn_by namespace is a new manually declared exact typed prerequisite, not a currently shipped common protocol.

Binder domain is the exact selected frozen scope; evaluate every member. each-member part_of/ownership/disjoint with a scalar endpoint requires actual graph/fact witness for each; explicit distinctness of actual IDs is not sufficient for disjointness. Alias equivalence only normalizes actual identity, never parts.

Scalar v2 guards stay scalar, even within a mapv4 proof. A scope endpoint in v1/v2 is invalid. New quantified guards retain the exact common/branch/member/presentation CID namespace, sealed condition frame hashes, selected RID and source dependency activation; optional unselected children add no obligations.

Do not add guard-only targets from member layers into another proof plan. Introduced synthetic point owners never satisfy existing scope membership or frozen relations. A source may only reference own/required-child endpoints allowed by the present condition layer.

Unknown or unresolved independent scope selection may produce search_only/review_required during discovery; a selected wrong/missing actual relation is a real denial. Final permission/adoption/runtime always require all active guards verified. No guard evaluator recursively calls admission; pure resolved effect scope supports preservation overlap checks.
